snippet.title: Albert  - Crazy game for iPhone and iPad by Fingerlab
snippet.description:
Albert  it is 14 mini games, 18 treasures to be found, many surprises for everyone in your family! 
This game is made for iPad,iPhone and iPodtouch!  Available exclusively on the App Store

☆ The HD Graphics were made from 1000 pieces of cardboard, sliced, glued, photographed and animated by hand. Which is what makes this game unique. 
☆ Holographic effects were studied to feel a better immersion in Albert's Universe.Tilt your iPad/iPhone from left to right and up and down to discover the flip-side of the image, its magic! 
☆ Albert's mini games use advanced technology the iPad/iPhone has: The speedometer, multi-touch, microphone. 
☆ You and your friends can share your scores through the game center, get connected. 
☆ Albert is translated in the following languages: French, German, Japanese, Italian, Spanish, English and chineses 

If Albert receives enough encouraging, other mini-games will come to see the day light, so do not hesitate to give this game many stars on Itunes.
Spend one day with Albert 
Have fun !!! 

Albert for iPhone and iPodtouch
http://itunes.com/apps/albert

Albert for iPad
http://itunes.com/apps/alberthd

If you want to discover Albert's Universe, you have access to a Lite version, this one has 3 mini-games. 
http://itunes.com/apps/albertlite free for iPhone and iPodtouch
http://itunes.com/apps/alberthdlite free foriPhone and iPodtouch 


VISIT US : www.fingerlab.net 
FOLLOW US : www.twitter.com/​fingerlab 
CONTACT US : contact@fingerlab.net 


Albert is a Fingerlab Studio creation, featured by apple several time for the game Mulitpong 
(iTunes rewind 2010, App of the week, Game starter kit, Huddle Game) 

Fingerlab team.
